states.title: Code - DevOps Loop
states.text: DevOps Loop: Code T TeamSpace: Team1 Branch: main ​ Running Dev Containers Other Dev Containers Cloud Native & DevOps Complete cloud-native development environment with Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, and multi-cloud CLI tools. Perfect for infrastructure engineers developing secure infrastructure-as-code with built-in policy validation. Cpp Cpp codeserver Data Science & ML Comprehensive data science environment with Python 3.11, Jupyter Lab, ML frameworks (TensorFlow, Scikit-learn), and MLflow. Enables data scientists to collaborate on experiments with version control and reproducibility built-in. .NET Enterprise .NET development environment with .NET 8, Entity Framework Core, and Azure CLI. Provides consistent development setup for distributed enterprise teams building modern .NET applications. Full-Stack Web Complete full-stack web development environment with Node.js, PostgreSQL client, Redis CLI, and API testing tools. Ideal for modern web application development with integrated database access. Go Modern Go development environment with Go 1.22, gRPC tools, and container registry CLI. Optimized for building cloud microservices with integrated linting, testing, and debugging. Mobile Development React Native and Expo development environment for building cross-platform iOS and Android applications. Eliminates local setup complexity with pre-configured emulator support and debugging tools. Node Node devcontainer Python Python codeserver RealTimeC++ Development of C++ realtime applications using Code RealTime Watsonx A full-featured Java 21 environment along with Watsonx code assistant extension Starter A basic environment for tasks like text editing and Git cloning, and includes the DevOps Code extension for integrating with tools like DevOps Plan.
